name: edrive
description: Real electric range (plug-in hybrids and fully electric cars such as the iX3), live battery power, cells and climate power, HV battery health (SOH) and energy, last charge, charge log, the 12 V battery (charge, voltage, what it does, regen, history) and a home-screen widget; on a 48 V mild hybrid its 48 V battery and DC/DC converter
author: cauliflowermossgrape
